Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney are the powerful opening pair for Australia Women. Fran Jonas is to bowl the first over...
... CHASE TIME ...

The bowling from Australia Women blew hot and cold in the first 15 overs or so. Their main weapon, the spinners, leaked too many runs in the middle overs and failed to exert any pressure. Megan Schutt and Tahlia McGrath impressed the most while Darcie Brown was economical in her 4-over spell. It's a below-par total on this surface and New Zealand Women will have to bowl exceptionally well to have a say during the chase. Stay tuned...

It was a decent recovery from New Zealand Women early in the innings despite losing Suzie Bates for a golden duck. The debutant Georgia Plimmer played a short but sparkling knock to help the White Ferns score some free runs in the Powerplay. The real partnership of substance came between Sophie Devine and Amelia Kerr, and when they were at the crease, a score close to 170 looked possible. However, they both departed in quick succession and there was a flurry of wickets after that.

Exceptional bowling show by Australia Women in the end overs to restrict New Zealand Women under 150. Five wickets fell in the last five overs and it hampered New Zealand's progress in the slog overs.

OUT! Run out to end proceedings in the first innings. A full toss around off, Green forces it down to mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder (Beth Mooney) collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end to find Green well short of her crease. New Zealand Women end on 144 for 7.
Bowls it on middle and on a good length, Hayley Jensen clips it towards square leg for one.
On a length and around off, Maddy Green looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits her pads and rolls towards the leg side. They cross for a leg bye.
Hayley Jensen is in next.

OUT! Halliday holes out this time! Schutt gets her third wicket. She serves it short and around off, Brooke powers it across the line but it comes from the outer half of her blade. It flies straight to Mooney who takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller again, Brooke Halliday gently lofts it above the bowler's head towards mid on. they collect two.
Fuller one on off, Maddy Green flicks it. The ball lands just short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. They cross.
Megan Schutt to bowl the final over.
DROPPED! Fuller in length and outside off, Brooke Halliday plays a mistimed lofted shot to long off where Jess Jonassen settles underneath it but fails to hold on to the catch. The batters take two.
Yorker and on middle, Maddy Green squeezes it towards mid off for one.
Maddy Green is the new batter.

OUT! Stumps shattered! New Zealand Women are falling away. A leg-stump yorker, at 107 kph, Tahuhu stays back and tries to dig it out but fails in her attempt. The leg stump goes for a walk and Australia Women are doing a great job to chip away at the wickets in the end overs.
Goes fuller again, Brooke Halliday drives but finds the fielder at covers. They cross.
Fuller and outside off, Brooke Halliday slaps it towards deep backward point for a brace.

NOT OUT! Full and outside off, Halliday steps back to make room and tries to drive but misses. Healy collects the ball and breaks the stumps. She appeals and it has been referred upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the outside edge which is absent. The side-on angle finds Halliday safe.
Stumping appeal. It's referred upstairs...
Tossed up, on middle and leg, Lea Tahuhu flicks it off the inner edge to fine leg. They collect two.
On off, Lea Tahuhu guides it towards the point fielder.
Tossed up on off, Brooke Halliday uses her feet to loft it again but doesn't get enough power to it. It falls just short of the fielder at long off. They cross.
FOUR! Another excellent shot from Brooke Halliday.​ Jess Jonassen delivers it full and around off, Brooke hammers it over mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! Fine shot! Floated delivery, landing full around middle, Brooke Halliday advances down the track and lifts it just over Tahlia McGrath at mid off. She chases it and tries to pull it back but fails in her attempt.
Tossed up, on off, Brooke Halliday defends it solidly.
Brooke Halliday walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two blows to New Zealand Women at the backend and both the set batters are now back in the pavilion. Change in pace from Tahlia McGrath. She hurls across a length ball around off, Amelia Kerr tries to heave it across the line but is early into the shot. It takes the top edge and Darcie Brown settles underneath it at short third man.
Commentary.Howout: c Darcie Brown b Tahlia McGrath

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Delicately played! Tahlia McGrath serves it a touch short and around off, Amelia Kerr plays late and guides it wide of short third man for a boundary.
Fuller and straighter, Lea Tahuhu eases it to long on for a single.
This one lands fuller as well, Amelia Kerr dabs it towards covers for one.
Fuller again, Amelia Kerr flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller one on off, Amelia Kerr uses her feet and lofts it towards long off. The fielder just stops it before the fence. They take a couple of runs.
Lea Tahuhu is the new batter. Also, Tahlia McGrath is back into the attack.

OUT! Devine holes out! Jess Jonassen has her revenge and this is a big wicket at the death for Australia Women. We all know how dangerous Sophie Devine can prove to be in the end overs. Fuller and around off, Sophie Devine sits down to play another slog sweep but this time it takes the top edge and Beth Mooney catches it at deep square leg. End of a wonderful knock by the New Zealand Women's skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Jess Jonassen

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on off, Sophie Devine looks to slog-sweep but misses as the ball hits her back thigh.

SIX! This one has gone all the way! Sophie Devine is motoring now and reaches her fifty. Again the length is a touch short, around middle, Sophie Devine gets down on one knee and smokes it over deep square leg.
FOUR! Struck well. A long hop around off, Sophie Devine goes deep inside the crease and hammer-pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, full and outside off, Devine gets across the stumps to play the sweep shot but fails to connect.
Short and around off, Kerr goes back and pulls it without much timing to long on. They cross.
On a length nad on middle, Sophie Devine flicks it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller again, Amelia Kerr gently plays it towards mid on for one.
Fuller one and on off, Sophie Devine plays it towards long on and takes one.
On middle this time and slightly shorter, Amelia Kerr pulls it towards mid-wicket for one.
Outside off again, Amelia Kerr looks to cut it but misses. The keeper fumbles a bit to collect. No run.
Touch fuller, outside off, Sophie Devine forces it down to long on for one.
Bowling change. Megan Schutt comes back into the attack. 2 for 10 in her two overs so far.
Fuller again, Sophie Devine plays it straight towards long on for one.
This one lands fuller and on middle, Sophie Devine nudges it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller again, Sophie Devine guides it towards the point fielder.
Tossed up, giving it some air, Sophie Devine plays it with soft hands back towards the bowler.
FOUR! The 50-run stand comes up! A loopy full toss on middle, Sophie Devine gives it the full whack of his bat and heaves it to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
Tossed up, on off, Amelia Kerr flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Fuller one on middle, Sophie Devine flicks it towards mid-wicket for a brace. This is good running between the wickets. Another 10-run over!
This one lands outside leg, Sophie Devine looks to sweep it but misses. Wide called.
Flighted up on off, Amelia Kerr sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Impressive shot! Loopy delivery, landing full and around off, Kerr dances down the track and thwacks it over the leaping bowler for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Sophie Devine pulls it towards deep square leg for one.
Fuller one this time, Sophie Devine hits it straight towards Jess Jonassen who collects it with one hand.
Slightly shorter outside off, Amelia Kerr gently flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Jess Jonassen comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Another lovely shot from Sophie Devine and the stand moves to 38. Fuller and around off, Sophie Devine drills it back past the bowler and since the field is up at mid off, it's a boundary. 10 from the over!
Tossed-up delivery, Sophie Devine guides it toward covers.
FOUR! Shot! Quicker one, fuller and around leg, Sophie Devine sweeps it firmly and finds the fence at deep backward square leg.
Flighted up, around middle and leg, Amelia Kerr sweeps it towards deep square leg for one more.
This is fuller and on off, Sophie Devine plays it towards the mid-on fielder.
Tossed up on leg, Sophie Devine looks to flick it but the ball hits her thigh.
Touch fuller this time, Amelia Kerr drives it but finds the fielder at covers.

NOT OUT! Tahlia serves it on a length just around off and gets it to shape back in sharply. Devine gets across and tries to heave but misses and is hit on the flap of the right pad. The appeal for an lbw is turned down as the batters cross. Meg Lanning takes the DRS but the Ball Tracking finds the impact to be with the umpire's call.
DRS is taken for the lbw shout by Australia Women.
Tahlia McGrath bowls it on a length and on off, this is guided towards long on for one.
On a length and just outside off, Sophie Devine knocks it to covers and takes a quick run.
Fuller and on off, Amelia Kerr taps it to point and rotates the strike.
Fuller one on off, Amelia Kerr drives it to covers.
Tahlia McGrath is back into the attack. She went for 11 runs in her opening over.
Tossed up, on middle and leg, Sophie Devine flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Turning in from around off, Kerr gets back and nudges it through mid-wicket for one.
Short and on middle, Kerr goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and around off, Devine pushes it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up, on off, Amelia Kerr flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller one on middle, Amelia Kerr goes on her knees and slog-sweeps. The ball goes in the air and lands safely at cow corner. They take a couple of runs.
Ashleigh Gardner comes into the attack.
Goes fuller outside off, Amelia Kerr guides it towards third man for one more. Darcie Brown has bowled out, 4-0-19-0.
Fuller and on leg, Sophie Devine flicks it aerially over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep stops it on one bounce, to her left, and the batters get one.
Pitched up, on middle, this is played towards mid on.
Bowls it outside off, Sophie Devine looks to play at it but misses.
Shorter one down the leg side, Amelia Kerr pulls it to backward square leg for one.
FOUR! Put away! The line is very straight from Brown, Amelia Kerr picks it up off her pads and whips it behind square leg for a boundary.
Darcie Brown to bowl out...
Slightly shorter, around middle and leg, Amelia Kerr goes down again but this time plays a controlled sweep shot behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! Floated delivery, full and landing on middle, Kerr goes down on one knee and slog-sweeps it in front of square on the leg side. Bisects the two fielders in the deep and finds the fence.
Tossed up on off, it drifts a bit, Amelia Kerr looks to play at it but misses as it hits her pads.
Flighted up, around off, Sophie Devine knocks it towards point for one.
Outside off and fuller in length, this is defended towards point.
Tossed up, around off, Amelia Kerr cuts it to point. The fielder stops it diving to her right. They cross.
Alana King is introduced into the attack.
Touch fuller delivery, Sophie Devine plays it back towards the bowler who gets her hand to it. No run.
Shorter one on middle, Sophie Devine ducks underneath it.
Goes on off and a touch fuller, Amelia Kerr flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On off and on a good length, Amelia Kerr looks to slap it but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces towards the keeper.
Delivers it on middle, this is defended out solidly.
On a length and outside leg, Amelia Kerr looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
Bowls it on a length and down the middle, Sophie Devine eases it to the cover fielder.
Darcie Brown is back on.
Sliding down the leg side, Kerr tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. At the end of the Powerplay, New Zealand Women are 39 for 2.
Play and a miss! Schutt delivers it from wide of the crease and hurls across an inswinger on a good length outside off. Kerr rocks back to cut but misses. That was not too far away from the off pole.
Fuller in length and around off, Amelia presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Short delivery outside off, Kerr cuts but finds the point fielder.
Amelia Kerr is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Schutt retorts by picking a wicket. This is beautiful bowling. A leg cutter is angled in around middle and off. Georgia Plimmer tries to defend by getting forward but it straightens a hint to beat the bat and goes on to shatter the stumps. Plimmer's promising knock comes to an end.
FOUR! Georgia Plimmer is showing her talent. Fuller in length and around off, Plimmer runs down the track and chips it over mid off for a boundary.
Megan Schutt comes back into the attack.
Slower length ball outside off, Sophie Devine tries to play late at it but fails to connect.
Helps a length ball in the gap at mid-wicket and picks up a run.
Wide! Down the leg side, Plimmer tries to flick but misses.
FOUR! Fine shot! The debutant is batting with freedom. Back of a length and outside off, Georgia Plimmer punches it from the back foot and finds the gap through point.
Full toss again, around off, Sophie forces it down to mid on where Alana King makes a sliding stop. Saves a certain boundary. Only one run is taken.
FOUR! Put away! A full toss around off, Sophie Devine goes down the ground with a straight drive and finds the fence. Fabulous timing.
Slower one, a touch short and outside off, Devine pushes inside the line and misses.
Tahlia McGrath comes into the attack.
Heaves a length ball off the inner half to deep square leg. Collects two.
A length ball around off, Plimmer pushes it from the back foot to point.
Another swing and a miss. Outside off, Plimmer flashes and misses.
Swing and a miss! Short and outside off, Georgia Plimmer walks forward to play an expansive pull shot but fails to connect.
Outside off, played down to point.
Width outside off, Sophie runs it down to third man for a single.
Two wides! Slips a length ball down the leg side. The batter leaves and the keeper fails to gather it cleanly. They cross.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Full and flighted, on middle and leg, Devine kneels down and nails her sweep shot wide of backward square leg for a boundary.
Full and on middle, swept across the line but found the square leg fielder.
Uses her feet and caresses a full ball down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Tossed up, full and outside off, Georgia Plimmer dances down the track and lofts it over mid off for her first boundary in international cricket.
Plimmer uses her feet again but this time drives a full ball back to the bowler.
Loopy and full, around off, Plimmer walks forward and drives it to covers.
Jess Jonassen comes into the attack.
Georgia Plimmer is off the mark in her debut game. Brown pitches it up around off, Plimmer strokes it towards mid off for a quick run.
On a length, around middle and leg, Georgia Plimmer tries to work it on the leg side but misses.
Bunts a length ball down to mid on and pinches a quick single.
Short in length, around leg and angling down, Devine tries to pull but it bounces over her gloves.
Gets on the front foot again and this time manages to drive it through covers for a couple.
Beaten all ends up! The ball is moving around quite nicely. An outswinger, around off, and on a fuller length, Devine is forward to drive but misses.
Darcie Brown to bowl from the other end.

GIVEN LBW! Massive inward movement for Schutt again. She lands it around off and gets it to swerve back into the batter. Georgia Plimmer, the debutant, tries to defend without getting forward much and is rapped on the front pad. The appeal is made and the finger goes up. Georgia consults her skipper and takes the DRS. The Ball Tracking shows that it has moved back in a big time and is missing the stumps. The debutant avoids a golden duck.
Georgia Plimmer is the new batter in.

OUT! DRAGS IT ON! That's a poor shot attempted by someone as experienced as Suzie Bates. It's on a length and outside off, seaming back in, Suzie Bates shows no footwork as she reaches out to cut the ball. She only manages an inside edge though and it cannons onto the stumps. Early success for Schutt and Australia Women.
Fuller and on middle, Sophie Devine clips it off the inner half through square leg for a single.

FIVE WIDES! New Zealand Women are up and running. Three dot balls and Megan decides to go 'round the wicket with the keeper up. The execution of the plan is not there though. Megan Schutt slips a length ball down the leg side. It beats both the batter and keeper before racing away to the fine leg fence.
Full and on middle, it's driven down the ground but straight to mid on.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to cover.
Starts with a length ball around off, shaping in off the seam, Devine defends it to mid-wicket.

We're minutes away from getting underway. The Australian team is on the field. Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine are the experienced opening pair of New Zealand Women. A smiling Megan Schutt gets ready to bowl the first over. Here we go...

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Sophie Devine (C), Suzie Bates, Amelia Kerr, Maddy Green, Brooke Halliday, Georgia Plimmer (In for Rosemary Mair), Hayley Jensen, Lea Tahuhu, Hannah Rowe, Izzy Gaze (WK), Fran Jonas.

Australia Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Tahlia McGrath, Rachael Haynes, Ashleigh Gardner, Grace Harris, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.
Toss - Meg Lanning wins the toss and AUSTRALIA WOMEN WILL BOWL FIRST!

Players to watch out for! Suzie Bates has been the leading run-scorer for New Zealand Women and will hold the key again. Hayley Jensen has been exceptional with the ball, getting good movement, and his team will be hoping for early wickets from her. Australia Women have 'Fab Four' in their batting ranks but barring Tahlia McGrath, we are yet to see consistency from the top order. Healy, Mooney, and Lanning have shown glimpses of form, and if they all click together, we will be in for a treat. The Australian bowling has been superb as well, and their spinners Jess Jonassen and Alana King, in particular, have done a great job. Some quality players will be on show, so expect an entertaining contest.
